settings.content: A card scented by hand, folded into a house envelope and closed with a wax seal. The button adds a $0.00 product to the parcel and goes straight to checkout, so Shopify collects and validates the address, the request lands in Orders ready to fulfil, and it creates a customer you can count. Offered on scented products — tagged fragrance or sample, typed as an eau de parfum, or with the metafield custom.free_sample set true. Withheld with the tag no-sample.

settings.label: Sample product handle
settings.info: The $0.00 product the button adds. It needs an address at checkout, so keep "This is a physical product" ticked. Track its inventory to cap how many go out.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: A card, scented by hand, in a house envelope under a wax seal. Hold it to your nose, or rub it on your wrist and let it warm — it is paper, not a vial, so there is nothing to spray. Tell us where to send it at checkout; the card and the postage are both ours.

settings.default: The cards are spoken for just now. The letter will say when more are scented.
